query: INSERT INTO fnr_aliases (function_id, alias, version_id, updated_by, updated_at) SELECT $1, * FROM UNNEST($2::text[], $3::text[], $4::text[], $5::timestamptz[]) ON CONFLICT (function_id, alias) DO UPDATE SET version_id = EXCLUDED.version_id, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
